$description: Component tokens for Divider. Path grammar: divider.<part>.<property>[.<orientation>]. A divider has no interaction state. Parts and options must exist in packages/components/specs/components/divider.spec.json. Values alias semantic tokens only (Figma library mapped colors and scales, and the additions).

margin-block.$description: Space above and below a horizontal divider.

margin-inline.$description: Space before and after a vertical divider.

min-height.$description: Height of a vertical divider when its container does not stretch it.
